sloka: रथेन खरयुक्तेन रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनः ।पिबंस्तैलं हसन् नृत्यन् भ्रान्तचित्ताकुलेन्द्रियः ।गर्दभेन ययौ शीघ्रं दक्षिणां दिशमास्थितः ।। ५.२७.२४।।।।
transliteration: rathena kharayuktena raktamālyānulepanaḥ ।pibaṁstailaṁ hasan nṛtyan bhrāntacittākulendriyaḥ ।gardabhena yayau śīghraṁ dakṣiṇāṁ diśamāsthitaḥ ।। 5.27.24।।।।

translations.english: "He was wearing red garlands and unguents, his body smeared with oil. He was drinking, laughing and dancing, his mind and senses perplexed. He was driving on a chariot yoked to donkeys.
